title: 2004 AMC 8 Problem 9
statement: The average of the five numbers in a list is \(54.\) The average of the first two numbers is \(48.\) What is the average of the last three numbers?

solutions.text:
The sum of all \(5\) numbers is \(54 \cdot 5 = 270.\) The sum of the first \(2\) numbers is \(48 \cdot 2 = 96.\)

The sum of the last \(3\) numbers is \(270 - 96 = 174.\) The average is therefore \(174 \div 3 = 58.\)

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Turn each average into a sum.
Subtract the sum of the first two numbers from the sum of all five.
